visualCharacteristics: Sidebar aside: the ministry logo link at the top, followed by the 'Schnellzugriff' list of quick links (its heading is visually hidden and labels the navigation).
contentPattern: One cell classified by content: a paragraph with an (optionally linked) image is the logo, a heading is the list title, a list of links is the shortcut links. Anything else stays visible after the list.
usage: Right-hand sidebar on the home page with the ministry logo and quick-access links.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for sidebar quick-link lists with an optional logo. For in-page link lists without a sidebar role use default content.
